method.train_primary: rank-0 adjacent step_start_time differences; cycle labels 0..4 excluded
method.train_supplementary: rank-0 time_ms across all 250 or 1,800 steps
method.profile_stable_window: intersection of two local profile intervals, trim 0.5 seconds from each boundary, match identical cycle step numbers in both baseline runs
method.profile_transaction: cycles fully inside global trigger-to-finish interval; report means to retain long-tail effects
method.collective_unit: one run is independent; per-rank 100-batch means are summarized within a run

monitor.measurement: rank-0 adjacent step_start_time cycle; cycle labels 0..4 excluded

observation.scope_note: This is the observed duration of this 1,800-step run; it is not evidence about weeks-long false-trigger rates.

collective.design: off/on pair (one independent run per variant)
collective.noise_suppression_note: The off/on pair is a single independent comparison and does not provide ABBA order balancing or ABBA noise suppression.
